main.description: A concrete workflow input or output, such as a RAW file, negative strip, print, or video clip. Artifact records form the nodes of a provenance graph; process stages connect those nodes and may accept multiple inputs, such as a negative and a mask used to make a print.

photo.description: The published photo AT-URI, when this artifact is a published photo (e.g. social.grain.photo).

intermediate.description: app.graycard.instance.intermediate, when the artifact is a persistent physical object.

parents.description: Artifacts this one was derived from (lineage edges).

producedBy.description: The app.graycard.process.* session that produced this artifact.

main.description: Camera model/type (e.g. Nikon F2). Instances reference this record. Projected into a photo's EXIF (e.g. social.grain.photo.exif) make/model when associated with a photo.

alternativeNames.description: Alternative model or EXIF labels for this camera. Clients use these names when matching imported photo metadata.

minShutterSpeed.description: Fastest shutter (shortest exposure), in seconds at 1e6 scale — e.g. 1/8000 s.

maxShutterSpeed.description: Slowest shutter (longest exposure), in seconds at 1e6 scale — e.g. 30 s.

flashSyncSpeed.description: Fastest normal flash-sync exposure in seconds at 1e6 scale, e.g. 1/250 s is 4000.

shutterSpeedSteps.description: Exact shutter speeds for the shot logger dial, in seconds at 1e6 scale. When present, overrides min/max and stop-fraction generation.

shutterStopIncrement.description: Default stop fraction when generating shutter options from min/max (shot logger may override when steps are absent).

isoMin.description: Lowest supported ISO/ASA setting, excluding special low extensions.

isoMax.description: Highest supported ISO/ASA setting, excluding special high extensions.

isoSteps.description: Exact supported ISO/ASA settings when the camera uses a discrete dial or menu.

exposureCompensationMin.description: Minimum exposure compensation in EV at 1e6 scale, usually negative.

exposureCompensationMax.description: Maximum exposure compensation in EV at 1e6 scale.

viewfinderCoverage.description: Viewfinder frame coverage as a proportion at 1e6 scale; 100% is 1000000.

viewfinderMagnification.description: Nominal viewfinder magnification ratio at 1e6 scale.

autofocusSystem.description: Manufacturer name or concise description of the autofocus system.

batteryTypes.description: Manufacturer-specified battery designations, preserving regional equivalents when useful.

weight.description: Manufacturer-specified body weight; notes or source location should state whether batteries are included.

sensorWidth.description: Active or effective sensor width, normally in millimetres.

sensorHeight.description: Active or effective sensor height, normally in millimetres.

storageMedia.description: Supported storage media or card standards.

rawFormats.description: Manufacturer RAW file formats or extensions supported by the camera.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

documents.description: Technical sheets, manuals, catalogs, and other documents consulted for this model.

specSources.description: Field-level assertions identifying the exact document location behind structured specifications.

dilutionOption.description: A supported stock or working dilution and its intended use.

mixingStep.description: One ordered step in preparing stock or working solution.

capacityRule.description: Published processing capacity for a stated amount of solution.

shelfLife.description: Published life of a concentrate, stock, or working solution under stated conditions.

temperatureRange.description: Supported operating or storage temperature interval.

hazardClassification.description: Public safety classification transcribed from an SDS; not a reproduction of a proprietary formula.

bathStep.description: One ordered bath in a multi-bath product kit.

roles.description: Atomic functions performed by this bath; e.g. bleach and fixer for a blix bath.

main.description: A photographic-chemistry product. Atomic roles distinguish film and paper developers, stop, fixer, bleach, wetting agent, and other functions without splitting them into separate record types.

roles.description: Atomic functions performed by this product. Combined baths use multiple entries: a monobath is film-developer plus fixer; blix is bleach plus fixer.

recommendedRecipes.description: Film-specific app.graycard.catalog.devRecipe records when this chemistry supplies the developer bath.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

tempPoint.description: A published development time at one temperature. Times are only ever shown for temperatures a manufacturer datasheet supports (interpolated within published points, never extrapolated).

tempC10.description: Temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius (20.0 C = 200).

timeSec.description: Development time in seconds at this temperature.

agitation.description: Agitation scheme, structured so a timer can drive a metronome.

initialSec.description: Continuous agitation at the start of the step.

everySec.description: Agitation cycle period (e.g. 60 = once a minute).

main.description: A development recipe: the time(s) to develop a given film at a given exposure index in a given developer/dilution, sourced from a manufacturer datasheet. Bundled curated recipes and user-saved personal recipes share this shape.

chemistryType.description: Preferred reference to an app.graycard.catalog.chemistryType whose roles include film-developer.

developerName.description: Name fallback for portable records or unresolved developer types.

filmName.description: Name fallback for portable records or unresolved film stocks.

ei.description: Exposure index the time is for; push/pull rows are separate recipes.

pushPull.description: Push or pull relative to box speed, in stops.

temps.description: One or more published (temperature, time) points. Multiple points enable interpolation between them.

recommendationStatus.description: Strength of the source's recommendation for this exact film/developer combination.

interpolationAllowed.description: Whether interpolation between published temperature/time points is supported.

derived.description: True when one or more operative values were calculated rather than printed directly in the source.

source.description: URL of the manufacturer datasheet this recipe was transcribed from.

main.description: An enlarger model (catalog). instance.enlarger references this.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

main.description: An enlarging (darkroom) lens model — distinct from camera lenses (e.g. Rodagon, Componon-S, EL-Nikkor). instance.enlargingLens references this.

coversFormat.description: Largest negative format the lens covers.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

formatVariant.description: A format-specific commercial variant. Base and packaging can differ while the emulsion remains the same.

baseThickness.description: Physical base thickness; micrometres are preferred.

reciprocityPoint.description: A published long-exposure correction at a metered exposure time.

resolvingPowerTest.description: A resolving-power measurement under a stated test contrast.

granularityMeasurement.description: A published granularity result together with enough test conditions to interpret it.

value.description: Published value multiplied by scale; scale defaults to 1.

spectralSample.description: One sample from a manufacturer spectral-sensitivity curve.

storageGuidance.description: Manufacturer storage conditions for unopened or exposed film.

main.description: Film emulsion type (catalog). Rolls reference this record.

iso.description: Box speed or lower end of a manufacturer-published ISO/ASA range.

isoMax.description: Upper end of a manufacturer-published ISO/ASA range when the stock is explicitly rated across more than one speed.

format.description: Primary/legacy format. Prefer `formats` for the full list.

formats.description: All formats this emulsion is sold in (from the datasheet).

base.description: Film base material, per the datasheet.

spectralSamples.description: Digitized samples of the manufacturer spectral-response curve.

resolvingPowerLpMm.description: Resolving power in lines/mm at high contrast (1000:1), per datasheet.

datasheetUrl.description: URL of the official manufacturer datasheet this record was farmed from.

aka.description: Other names the SAME emulsion is sold under (e.g. a rebrand: Ektacolor Pro 400 is Portra 400). Facts, not AT-URIs, so two brandings can be treated as one film even before both exist as records.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

documents.description: Manufacturer documents used for this catalog record, including technical sheets and processing charts.

main.description: A lens filter model (catalog). Filter instances reference this record.

threadDiameterMm.description: Nominal filter thread diameter in mm (e.g. 52, 67, 77).

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

geo.description: Precise map location of the lab, set via the map picker.

alternativeNames.description: Alternative model or EXIF labels for this lens. Clients use these names when matching imported photo metadata.

mounts.description: All mounts in which the optical model was offered. mount remains the primary/legacy value.

variants.description: Mount- or market-specific versions of this optical model.

apertureSteps.description: Exact f-numbers for the shot logger dial at 1e6 scale. When present, overrides min/max and stop-fraction generation.

apertureStopIncrement.description: Default stop fraction when generating aperture options from min/max (shot logger may override when steps are absent).

closestFocus.description: Minimum focusing distance as specified by the manufacturer.

maxReproductionRatio.description: Maximum image-to-subject reproduction ratio at 1e6 scale; 1:1 is 1000000 and 1:2 is 500000.

filterThreadDiameter.description: Front filter thread diameter, normally in millimetres.

stabilized.description: Whether the lens includes optical image stabilization.

stabilizationStops.description: Manufacturer-rated stabilization benefit in stops at 1e6 scale.

imageCircleDiameter.description: Usable image-circle diameter at the manufacturer-specified focus/aperture.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

specSources.description: Field-level assertions identifying the exact document location behind structured specifications.

variant.description: A mount- or market-specific version of a lens model.

main.description: A UV / contact-printing exposure light source (for alternative processes and contact printing). instance.lightSource references this. (Enlarger illumination lives on enlargerType.headType instead.)

peakWavelengthNm.description: Peak UV wavelength (e.g. 365, 395); alt processes want ~350-400nm.

integrator.description: Has a light integrator (exposure measured in units, compensating for lamp aging).

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

main.description: A light-meter model in the shareable gear catalog (handheld ambient/spot/flash meters, color meters, and phone-app meters). Mirrors the conventions of the other catalog.* records: manufacturer identity, structured specifications, and edition-aware document citations via defs#productDocument / defs#specSource.

spotAngle.description: Spot acceptance angle in degrees (1 for a true spot meter).

receptorSwivel.description: Whether the incident receptor head swivels/rotates.

retractableDome.description: Whether the lumisphere retracts to a flat receptor.

luminanceModes.description: Whether direct luminance/illuminance display modes (lx, fc, cd/m², fL) are offered.

cineModes.description: Whether frame-rate / shutter-angle cine modes are offered.

constantK.description: Manufacturer reflected calibration constant, when published.

constantC.description: Manufacturer incident calibration constant, when published.

medium.description: What kind of printing paper this is.

base.description: Paper base: fiber (FB), resin-coated (RC), or baryta.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

main.description: A photographic printing paper (catalog): medium, base, surface, contrast, tone, and weight.
A photographic printer model — inkjet, dye-sublimation, or digital-lab (Lightjet/Chromira). instance.printer references this.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

main.description: Scanner or digitization device model/type. Scanner instances reference this record.

image.description: Product photo for this type, typically the manufacturer box/product shot. When unset, clients fall back to a Wikidata image.

datasheet.description: Official datasheet: a link (preferred), an uploaded file, or another record.

main.description: A reusable scan profile (resolution, method, inversion) applied when digitizing.

scaledInteger.description: Fixed-point number scaled by 1,000,000. Used for values projected into a photo's EXIF record (e.g. social.grain.photo.exif), which stores numerics at this fixed scale. Prefer #measure for graycard-native quantities.

measure.description: Self-describing scaled quantity. The real value is value / scale; scale defaults to 1 when absent. unit names the physical unit (e.g. celsius, dpi, stop, ev, mm, second, ml).

geoLocation.description: A geographic location. latitude/longitude are integer degrees scaled by 1e7 (real value = value / 1e7); altitude and accuracy are integer millimetres (real metres = value / 1000). placemark is an optional reverse-geocoded address. Storing scaled integers keeps atproto-native precision (~1cm) without a float type.

altitude.description: Metres above sea level, in millimetres (scaled by 1000).

placemark.description: A human-readable, reverse-geocoded address for a geoLocation.

temporalRef.description: Optional temporal grounding for video-readiness. When absent the subject is a single still frame; when present it selects a frame or time range within a clip.

externalId.description: A link to a canonical identifier in an external ontology or database.

catalogLinks.description: Optional links relating a catalog type to equivalents elsewhere and to external ontologies. Makes every type shareable, forkable, and dedupable across repos.

sameAs.description: Equivalent catalog type in another repo.

forkedFrom.description: Catalog type this record was copied from.

externalIds.description: Canonical identifiers in external ontologies (Wikidata, camera-wiki, Getty AAT, etc.).

provenance.description: How and when a value was asserted.

fieldProvenance.description: Provenance for a single named field within a record, so make can come from EXIF while aperture is entered by hand.

sourceFile.description: External source file (RAW, TIFF) not stored in the photo blob.

assetRef.description: Reference to an asset that belongs to a catalog type: a product photo, a datasheet. Exactly one of url / file / record should be set. A url is preferred: it points at the publisher's own copy, so third-party material (manufacturer product photography, datasheet PDFs) is linked rather than redistributed. Use file only for assets you may lawfully host (your own photograph, a permissively licensed one); use record to point at another atproto record holding the asset.

url.description: Link to the asset where its publisher hosts it (preferred).

file.description: The asset itself, uploaded to this repo. Only for content you may lawfully host.

record.description: Another atproto record holding the asset.

mimeType.description: Media type, useful when a url or record does not advertise one.

source.description: Who published the asset (e.g. "Eastman Kodak Company"), for attribution.

license.description: License or usage terms of the asset, when known.

productDocument.description: A manufacturer or other publisher document used to establish catalog specifications. The asset points to the document; the remaining fields identify the exact edition consulted.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag when known, e.g. en or de-CH.

supersedes.description: Older catalog document record superseded by this edition, when one exists.

specSource.description: Field-level provenance connecting one or more catalog fields to the exact document location and transcription method that supports them.

fields.description: Catalog property names supported by this assertion.

physicalDimensions.description: Physical product dimensions. Clients should inspect each measure's unit; millimetres are preferred for catalog interchange.

captureFormat.description: The physical format/size of the recorded frame. Open list — grouped: film roll, sheet, instant, cine, digital sensor.

tankType.description: How the film/paper was agitated in processing.

negativeFormat.description: A negative size, as used by enlargers and enlarging lenses.

inversionMethod.description: How a scanned negative was inverted to a positive.

projectMode.description: How defaulted/derived metadata is applied to a record.

stopFraction.description: Exposure dial increment as a fraction of a full stop (aperture or shutter).

chemistryProductKind.description: How a photographic-chemistry product is packaged. This is independent of the chemical functions it performs.

chemistryRole.description: One atomic function performed by a photographic chemical, bath, or water step. Combined baths carry more than one role. The wash value represents a water-washing operation; wash-aid identifies a chemical treatment that shortens or improves washing.

main.description: A reproducible, shareable edit: the engine-native edit graph (module DAG / history stack) that produced a derivative. graph is an opaque, versioned bundle owned by the editing engine; schemaVersion lets a reader migrate it. Complements process.editSession, which records the human-facing event.

schemaVersion.description: Identity/version of the edit-graph schema, for migration.

subject.description: The photo or artifact this recipe renders.

baseArtifact.description: Input artifact the recipe starts from.

main.description: Default gear/film/location/workflow applied to a gallery's photos that lack their own capture record.
A specific camera body (e.g. one of two Nikon F2s). References app.graycard.catalog.cameraType.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

componentName.description: For a process kit, the particular bath or component represented by this instance. Separate instances allow each mixed bath to have its own lifecycle dates.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of this chemistry instance.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent recorded use of this chemistry in a process session.

maxRollsRecommended.description: Manufacturer or user limit before replenishment or discard.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: A specific photographic chemical, working solution, or separately tracked bath from a process kit. References catalog.chemistryType.

type.description: Optional catalog enlarger type when defined.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: A specific enlarger the user owns. References catalog.enlargerType.
A specific enlarging lens the user owns. References catalog.enlargingLensType.

image.description: Optional user photo; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: A single logged exposure (a shot). Works for film (references a roll + frame number) and digital (no roll). Optionally belongs to a shoot and links to a published photo by AT-URI. Everything except createdAt is optional so shots can be logged fast in the field.

shoot.description: Optional app.graycard.session.capture this exposure belongs to.

frameNumber.description: Position on the roll (film). Optional. Several exposures may share one frameNumber: that is a multiple exposure on a single physical frame.

multipleExposure.description: True when this exposure is one of several deliberately stacked on the same physical frame (double/multiple exposure). All sub-exposures of the frame carry this flag and share roll + frameNumber.

frameExposureIndex.description: 1-based order of this sub-exposure within a multiple-exposure frame (1 for the first).

aperture.description: Chosen f-number as shown on the dial, e.g. '5.6', '8', '3.4'.

shutterSpeed.description: Chosen shutter speed as shown, e.g. '1/500', '1s', 'B'.

focalLength.description: Focal length used in mm (for zoom lenses).

meterReadings.description: Optional app.graycard.meter.reading records that informed this exposure, in the order they were taken. The canonical reading→exposure aggregation.

shotAtIso.description: Exposure index this frame was rated at, if it differs from the roll/stock speed.

photo.description: Optional photo (AT-URI) this exposure was scanned/published as, e.g. a social.grain.photo.

timeZone.description: IANA time-zone identifier recorded at capture, such as America/New_York. This preserves the local-time context of takenAt without publishing a second timestamp.

sourceIdentifier.description: Stable identifier supplied by an import source. Clients use this to detect a repeated import without duplicating an exposure.

provenance.description: How this exposure's data was asserted — e.g. manually logged vs imported from EXIF.

main.description: One physical roll of film. References app.graycard.catalog.filmStock. Unshot reserves live in app.graycard.instance.filmStockpile; exposed frames link via app.graycard.instance.filmFrame.

quantity.description: DEPRECATED: reserve counts now live in app.graycard.instance.filmStockpile. Retained only to read legacy rolls; a filmRoll is one physical roll.

shotAtIso.description: Exposure index the roll was actually rated at (push/pull), if it differs from the stock's box speed.

developedWith.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.chemistry used as the primary developer or multi-role bath for this roll.

lab.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.labAccount that developed the roll (when lab-developed rather than home-developed).

stockpile.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.filmStockpile this roll was split from.

loadedAt.description: When this roll was loaded into a camera.

partialAt.description: When the first exposure was made on this roll.

exposedAt.description: When this roll became fully exposed.

unloadedAt.description: When this roll was unloaded from its camera.

sentToLabAt.description: When this roll was sent or delivered to a lab.

developmentStartedAt.description: When development of this roll began.

developedAt.description: When development of this roll finished.

receivedFromLabAt.description: When this developed roll was received from a lab.

scannedAt.description: When this roll was first digitized.

finishedAt.description: DEPRECATED: ambiguous legacy completion date. Prefer exposedAt or developedAt.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: Unshot film held in reserve: a count of identical rolls of one stock, kept in some storage. Loading a roll decrements the quantity and spawns an app.graycard.instance.filmRoll.

stock.description: app.graycard.catalog.filmStock this reserve is made of.

quantity.description: How many unshot rolls of this stock are on hand.

storageLocation.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.storageLocation where the reserve is kept.

image.description: Optional photo; falls back to the stock's catalog image.

main.description: A physical lens filter the user owns. References app.graycard.catalog.filterType.

threadSize.description: This copy's thread size in mm, if it differs from the catalog default.

image.description: Optional photo of this filter; falls back to the catalog type's image.

main.description: Persistent intermediate artifact (negative strip, slide mount, glass plate, print). kind uses the shared artifact taxonomy.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: The user's account/relationship with a photo lab. References catalog.lab.
A specific lens copy. References app.graycard.catalog.lensType.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: A specific UV / contact-printing exposure unit the user owns. References catalog.lightSourceType.

image.description: Optional user photo; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: An owned metering instrument: a handheld meter referencing its catalog.meterType, or a phone acting as a meter (kind 'phone-camera', identified by deviceModel). Instance conventions follow the other instance.* records. Calibration state lives in app.graycard.meter.calibration records that reference this instance, so recalibration never rewrites gear identity.

type.description: Optional app.graycard.catalog.meterType (handheld meters and cataloged apps).

kind.description: What sort of instrument this is. 'in-camera' lets a camera body's own meter be cited as a reading source.

camera.description: For kind 'in-camera': the app.graycard.instance.camera whose built-in meter this is.

deviceModel.description: For phone meters: hardware identifier, e.g. 'iPhone17,2'.

main.description: A specific printer the user owns/uses. References catalog.printerType.

image.description: Optional user photo; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: A specific scanner or copy-stand rig. References app.graycard.catalog.scannerType.

image.description: Optional user photo of this specific item; falls back to the catalog type's stock image.

main.description: A place the user stores film, prints, or gear (fridge, freezer, dry cabinet, shelf).

A calibration profile for a metering instrument — most importantly a phone acting as a meter, where each camera module and sensor path needs its own correction. Stored in the repo so profiles roam across app installs. A reading references the profile that was applied to it, keeping every value auditable.

referenceDetail.description: The specific reference, e.g. 'Sekonic L-758DR s/n …', 'sunny-16, clear noon 2026-06-14'.

offsetStops.description: Global correction applied to raw engine EV, in stops (positive = engine reads dark).

constantK.description: Reflected-light calibration constant K in cd·s/(m²·ISO) this profile targets (default 12.5).

constantCFlat.description: Incident flat-receptor constant C in lx·s/ISO (commonly 250).

constantCDome.description: Incident hemispherical-receptor constant C in lx·s/ISO (commonly 330).

curve.description: Optional non-linear correction: (engine EV → corrected EV) control points, interpolated linearly between points.

validEvMin.description: Lower bound of the validated range (EV100).

validEvMax.description: Upper bound of the validated range (EV100).

deviceModel.description: Hardware identifier the profile was made on, e.g. 'iPhone17,2', so a restored account on new hardware knows to recalibrate.

osVersion.description: OS build at calibration time; camera pipelines change between releases.

supersedes.description: Previous calibration this one replaces, forming an auditable chain.

meterGeometry.description: How light was gathered for a reading. Incident measures light falling on the subject (dome integrates 3D form; flat disc measures a plane); reflected measures light returning from the scene, either wide-field or through spot optics.

lightKind.description: The temporal character of the measured light.

priorityMode.description: Which exposure variable the meter solved for: aperture priority solves shutter, shutter priority solves aperture, iso priority holds time and aperture and solves sensitivity; ev reports EV only.

flashSyncMode.description: How a flash measurement was triggered/integrated.

readingRole.description: Role of this reading within a multi-reading workflow (spot memory sets, averaging, contrast evaluation). 'single' is a standalone reading; members of a set share a seriesId.

sensorPath.description: For camera-based (phone) meters: which measurement path produced the value. 'ae-metadata' derives EV from the camera's auto-exposure state; 'raw-patch' integrates linear RAW pixels over the spot patch; 'processed-patch' estimates from tone-mapped frames; 'dedicated-cell' is a hardware photocell (handheld meters).

cameraModule.description: Phone camera module used for a camera-based reading.

calibrationReference.description: What a calibration profile was derived against.

main.description: A light-meter reading containing an observed photometric quantity, observation geometry, instrument, and optional exposure solution. It supports phone meters, handheld ambient or spot meters, and imported flash-meter readings. geometry, lightKind, and createdAt are required; other fields may be added afterward. ev100, illuminance, and luminance store measurements, while exposure stores the displayed solution and its compensation, filters, and reciprocity adjustment.

meter.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.meter that took the reading (a handheld meter, or a phone acting as one).

calibration.description: Optional app.graycard.meter.calibration profile applied to this reading.

ev100.description: Exposure value normalized to ISO 100 (unit 'EV'). The canonical photometric result for exposure purposes.

illuminance.description: Incident illuminance (unit 'lx'; clients may display fc). Canonical for incident readings.

luminance.description: Reflected luminance (unit 'cd/m2'; clients may display fL). Canonical for reflected/spot readings.

calibrationConstant.description: The ISO 2720 constant used to relate photometry to exposure for this reading: K in cd·s/(m²·ISO) for reflected (commonly 12.5), C in lx·s/ISO for incident (commonly 250 flat / 330 dome). Recorded so readings from differently-calibrated instruments remain comparable.

nominalSpotAngle.description: Advertised acceptance angle of the spot optics in degrees (1 for a true spot meter).

achievedSpotAngle.description: Acceptance angle actually integrated for this reading, in degrees. For phone spot metering this is the optics-limited value and may exceed the requested angle.

spotPoint.description: Where in the preview frame the spot patch was centered, normalized [0,1] × 1e6 (see app.graycard.defs#scaledInteger convention used by scene regions).

previewPhoto.description: Optional photo record (e.g. social.grain.photo) of the metered scene/preview frame the spotPoint refers to.

iso.description: Sensitivity the exposure solution is stated at (arithmetic ISO). Fractional ISO below 1 (e.g. 0.8) may be expressed via exposureCompensation instead.

aperture.description: Solved or held f-number as displayed, e.g. '5.6', '1.0', '90' (matches instance.exposure dial convention).

shutterSeconds.description: Solved or held exposure time in seconds (unit 's'). Long exposures store the reciprocity-corrected value here when reciprocity is applied; see reciprocity.

exposureCompensation.description: Compensation applied to the solution in EV, e.g. '-0.5', '+1'.

frameRate.description: Cine mode: frame rate in fps.

shutterAngle.description: Cine mode: shutter angle in degrees (time = angle / (360 × fps)).

filter.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.filter whose factor is included in the solution.

filterCompensation.description: Total filter/ND compensation folded into the solution, in stops.

reciprocity.description: Reciprocity-failure correction applied to the solution.

flash.description: Flash-metering details (typically imported from a dedicated flash meter).

flashPercent.description: Flash contribution to total exposure, percent (the flash/ambient analysis figure).

cumulativeCount.description: Number of pops accumulated for a multiple-flash reading.

duration.description: Measured flash duration in seconds at the stated threshold.

durationThreshold.description: Duration threshold convention, e.g. 't0.5', 't0.1' (fraction of peak intensity the duration is measured at).

seriesId.description: Groups readings taken as one workflow set (spot memory bank, averaging session, contrast evaluation). Members share the id.

averagedFrom.description: For role 'average': the member readings combined into this value.

targetZone.description: Zone System placement of the metered area (0–X). The exposure solution reflects this placement.

placementOffset.description: Stops offset from meter-indicated middle gray applied by placement (targetZone − 5, or a free offset), in stops.

colorTemperature.description: Correlated color temperature in kelvin, when the instrument measures it.

flags.description: Instrument caveats attached to the value, e.g. 'out-of-range-low', 'out-of-range-high', 'flare-risk', 'uncalibrated', 'approximate-incident'.

subject.description: What was metered, e.g. 'north rock face, shadow under overhang'.

exposure.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.exposure this reading informed. The exposure record's meterReadings array is the canonical aggregation; this back-reference is a convenience.

shoot.description: Optional app.graycard.session.capture this reading belongs to.

main.description: Per-photo graycard capture metadata (gear, film, frame, location) layered onto a grain photo.
Links a photo to the workflow run that produced it.

step.description: One ordered chemical bath or physical operation in a film-development process.

name.description: Human-readable bath or operation name, such as 'Wash' or 'Bleach + fix'.

sourceDocument.description: Structured manufacturer document used when no catalog recipe record is available.

sourceSpec.description: Exact source location supporting this stage's selected processing values.

kind.description: The physical kind of stage. roles may be empty for a stage such as drying or re-exposure.

roles.description: Atomic functions performed in this bath step.

chemistries.description: All tracked app.graycard.instance.chemistry records combined in or otherwise consumed by this stage. The first item is the primary chemistry when the distinction matters.

plannedTimeSeconds.description: Time selected before processing. Unlike publishedTimeSeconds, this may be a recipe interpolation, a general estimate, or a manually entered plan.

volumeMl.description: Working bath volume used for this stage.

disposition.description: What happened to the bath after this session.

main.description: One development event. References photographic chemistry and optionally film roll instances. steps captures the ordered bath sequence for multi-step chemistry.

filmRolls.description: app.graycard.instance.filmRoll(s) developed in this session (one or more).

steps.description: Ordered baths and physical operations. Recipe, chemistry, observations, and agitation belong to the stage where they occurred.

labService.description: Free-text lab name when the roll was developed by a lab.

lab.description: app.graycard.instance.labAccount that developed the roll (structured alternative to labService).

developmentLocation.description: Where this development session was performed. This keeps the session self-describing when its linked rolls change.

main.description: One digitization event (scan, copy-stand capture, lab scan, file import).

photos.description: Resulting photo records (e.g. social.grain.photo) produced by the scan.

recipe.description: app.graycard.edit.recipe capturing the reproducible edit graph.

main.description: One editing event — software and adjustments applied to a photo.
One equipment-maintenance event (CLA, sensor clean, shutter service, calibration) on a piece of gear.

filtration.description: Dichroic / colour-head filtration for RA-4 or variable-contrast printing. CMY values are head units as printed on the enlarger; magentaGrade is the multigrade contrast grade when using a B&W VC head.

wetProcess.description: Paper processing chain for a chemically-developed print (silver-gelatin, RA-4).

developerName.description: Free-text developer when not a tracked instance.

altProcess.description: Hand-coated / UV-exposed alternative process parameters (cyanotype, pt/pd, salt, van dyke, gum, carbon, …).

coats.description: Number of sensitizer coats / printing layers (gum bichromate is multi-layer).

exposureUnits.description: Integrator units when exposure is measured in units rather than seconds (light source is the top-level `lightSource` ref).

humidityPct.description: Ambient/paper humidity in percent (matters for pt/pd).

toningStep.description: One toning bath (prints may be split-toned in sequence).

main.description: One print made in the darkroom or on a printer. Covers silver-gelatin and RA-4 enlarging/contact printing, hand-coated alternative processes, and inkjet / digital-lab output. Workflow-specific detail lives in the enlargement/wetProcess/altProcess/digital sub-objects; fill only what applies.

printMethod.description: How the image reached the paper.

subject.description: What was printed — a photo (social.grain.photo) or scene subject.

filmRoll.description: Source roll (analog), when printing from a negative.

sourcePhoto.description: Digital source file/photo for inkjet or digital-lab prints.

paperInstance.description: Free-text paper batch/box when not a tracked type.

size.description: Print/paper size, e.g. '8x10 in', '16x20 in', '30x40 cm'.

lightSource.description: app.graycard.instance.lightSource (UV/contact exposure unit) — for alt-process and contact printing.

toner.description: Primary toner (app.graycard.instance.chemistry). Use `toning` for multiple/split toning.

labService.description: Lab name when the print was made by a lab.

main.description: One render or export event that materializes digital output from existing workflow artifacts. Editing decisions belong in app.graycard.edit.recipe and app.graycard.process.editSession; artifact lineage belongs in app.graycard.artifact.

sourceArtifacts.description: Input app.graycard.artifact records rendered or exported in this event.

outputArtifacts.description: Output app.graycard.artifact records produced by this event. Each output should also identify this session in artifact.producedBy.

recipe.description: app.graycard.edit.recipe used to render the output, when applicable.

quality.description: Encoder quality on a 0–100 scale, when the output format exposes that setting.

comparison.description: A leaf predicate over a dotted field path (e.g. exif.make, alt, gallery.title, capture.camera, index).

booleanGroup.description: A boolean combination of conditions. For 'not', supply a single operand.

action.description: A single mutation applied when the condition holds. value supports {{field.path}} template substitution.

main.description: Saved conditional batch rule for gallery-wide edits, with a typed predicate/action DSL so any client interprets it the same way.

regionKind.description: How a region is grounded onto the image plane. Covers the representations common in modern CV (detection, instance/panoptic segmentation, keypoints, oriented detection, 3D).

bbox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in normalized [0,1] coordinates scaled by 1,000,000 (origin top-left; x,y = top-left, w,h = size — COCO-style).

term.description: A reference to a node or edge type declared in an ontology. Either an in-repo ontology term (ontology AT-URI + local id) or an external CURIE/URI.

id.description: Local term id within the ontology, a CURIE (e.g. wd:Q7378), or a URI.

label.description: Human-readable label for the term (e.g. the Wikidata entity label).

rbox.description: Rotated / oriented bounding box (OBB). Center + size in normalized [0,1] scaled by 1,000,000; angleDeg in degrees scaled by 1,000,000 (counter-clockwise).

main.description: A typed relation between two scene nodes (panproto 'relates'). Its type references an ontology edge term.

Container binding a set of scene nodes and edges to a subject (a photo AT-URI or a graycard artifact). Nodes and edges reference this record. schemaVersion pins the panproto theory for round-trip migration.

subject.description: A photo (AT-URI) or app.graycard.artifact this graph describes.

ontologies.description: Ontologies whose terms this graph uses.

main.description: A typed vertex in a scene graph (panproto Entity/Event/Region/etc.). Its type references an ontology term; attrs carries an open attribute bundle.

attrs.description: Open attribute bundle keyed by ontology attribute terms.

typeDecl.description: Defines one node type or relation type. Relation types may specify inverse, opposite, symmetric, transitive, reflexive, and functional properties. domain and range are declared source and target preferences. domainIncludes and rangeIncludes are non-exhaustive observations from scene graphs, not constraints. sameAs associates the term with external identifiers.

id.description: Local term id, unique within this ontology.

domain.description: For relation types, the preferred source node-type IDs.

range.description: For relation types, the preferred target node-type IDs.

domainIncludes.description: Non-exhaustive source node types observed on relation instances. This field is not a constraint.

rangeIncludes.description: Non-exhaustive target node types observed on relation instances. This field is not a constraint.

inverse.description: ID of the converse relation type, such as has-part for part-of. The converse swaps source and target. A symmetric relation is its own inverse.

opposite.description: ID of the directional opposite, such as out-of for into. An opposite retains source and target; an inverse swaps them.

symmetric.description: For edge types: A rel B implies B rel A.

transitive.description: For edge types: A rel B and B rel C implies A rel C.

reflexive.description: For edge types: A rel A always holds.

functional.description: For edge types: each source relates to at most one target.

main.description: A shareable vocabulary for scene graphs. nodeTypes defines concepts and edgeTypes defines relations. Scene node and edge records hold observed instances; domainIncludes and rangeIncludes summarize the node types seen in those records. An observed instance relation does not create a type-level axiom. schemaVersion identifies the Panproto theory used by the vocabulary.

schemaVersion.description: Identity/version of the underlying panproto theory this vocabulary realizes.

nodeTypes.description: The concept (node) types in the vocabulary.

edgeTypes.description: The relation (edge) types in the vocabulary, with algebra and domain/codomain (asserted preferences + observed witnesses).

imports.description: Other ontologies composed into this one.

main.description: A grounded region on a photo (the panproto 'grounds' target). Supports bounding boxes, rotated boxes, polygons, raster/RLE masks, points, keypoints, and 3D cuboids so any CV output can attach to a scene node.

photo.description: A photo (AT-URI) or app.graycard.artifact grounded onto.

geometry.description: Open geometry for kinds not covered by bbox/rbox: polygon `points:[[x,y],...]`, multipolygon `polygons:[[[x,y],...],...]`, RLE `rle:{size:[h,w],counts}`, keypoints `keypoints:[[x,y,v],...]`, cuboid corners, etc. Coordinates normalized [0,1] scaled by 1e6 unless the `format` says otherwise.

format.description: Source encoding hint for consumers, e.g. coco-polygon, coco-rle, yolo-obb, sam-mask, sam2-masklet, labelme-polygon, graycard-polygon.

main.description: A shoot: a shooting session that gathers the gear used and the exposures made under shared context. Supports multiple cameras (each with their lenses) and, for film cameras, multiple rolls. Exposures reference the shoot via app.graycard.instance.exposure#shoot.

cameras.description: app.graycard.instance.camera bodies used in this shoot.

lenses.description: app.graycard.instance.lens lenses available in this shoot.

rolls.description: app.graycard.instance.filmRoll rolls loaded/shot in this shoot (film cameras).

filters.description: app.graycard.instance.filter filters available in this shoot.

places.description: Manually added locations for the shoot. The shoot's effective locations are these plus the locations of its exposures (inherited, not duplicated here).

main.description: A publicly discoverable photography setup. Opting in writes one of these to the user's own repo; its `registry` field links to a well-known discovery anchor so a shared backlink index (Constellation) can enumerate every published setup across the network without any backend.

registry.description: Discovery anchor. MUST equal the frozen HYPO_REGISTRY constant; it is the link Constellation indexes to find this setup.

name.description: Short human title for the setup, shown on its Discover card.

summary.description: Optional longer description of the setup.

gear.description: Optional AT-URIs of the author's app.graycard.* library items (cameras, lenses, film, scanners) to highlight.

schemaVersion.description: Optional Panproto lexicon release written by this client, used to label cross-version records and locate a verified migration chain.

artifactKind.description: Artifact kinds shared by workflow stages, app.graycard.artifact, and app.graycard.instance.intermediate.

stageKind.description: A workflow operation. Known values cover Hypo's built-in stage editors; custom values remain valid.

sessionScope.description: How process-session records are shared when a template is instantiated.

cardinality.description: Allowed occurrence count. An absent max is unbounded. Domain validation checks max >= min.

port.description: A named input or output on a template step. artifactKinds lists the values the port can carry.

external.description: Whether a run may satisfy this port directly from a run subject or expose it as a run product.

processDefaults.description: Typed defaults used to create or populate the process session associated with a stage.

params.description: Stage-kind-specific process defaults not yet represented by a shared typed field.

stageDefaults.description: Typed defaults written on the workflow-stage record rather than its process session.

params.description: Stage-kind-specific stage defaults not yet represented by a shared typed field.

templateStep.description: A stable, identified step in an ordered workflow template. IDs, rather than kinds, distinguish repeated operations.

templateConnection.description: A directed artifact flow between a source output port and target input port.

publishTarget.description: A terminal destination a workflow publishes to. Abstracts the publish target (e.g. social.grain.photo) so other targets can be added without a contract change.

ref.description: The published record, e.g. a social.grain.photo AT-URI.

artifactRef.description: A reference to an artifact flowing through a stage. ref may point at an app.graycard.artifact record (preferred) or any AT-URI; kind names its taxonomy slot.

artifactBinding.description: Binds a named template port to an artifact in a planned or performed stage.

templateStepId.description: Stable ID of the template step instantiated by this stage.

occurrence.description: One-based occurrence when a cardinality permits repeated stage instances.

branchLink.description: Legacy run-stage branch edge. New template topology uses templateConnection.

templateConnectionId.description: Stable ID of the template connection instantiated by this run edge.

main.description: One planned or performed workflow trace, with general subjects/products and ordered stage records.

photo.description: Legacy convenience for a single published-photo product. Prefer products.

subjects.description: Scenes, rolls, negatives, files, prints, or other artifacts this run starts from.

products.description: Artifacts or publications produced by this run.

template.description: The app.graycard.workflow.template instantiated by this run.

templateRevision.description: Template CID or application revision captured when the run was planned.

templateName.description: Display-name snapshot retained if the template is later renamed or deleted.

topology.description: How stage dependencies are interpreted. graph treats branches as the complete edge set, including an intentionally empty graph.

optional.description: Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.

outputs.description: All outputs, including the primary compatibility output when present.

session.description: Deprecated alias of shoot. When present, references app.graycard.session.capture.

shoot.description: app.graycard.session.capture for the shoot represented by this stage.

optional.description: Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.
Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.

digitalStage.description: A render or export stage that materializes a digital output artifact. Editing decisions belong in editStage; the digitalStage name is retained for compatibility with existing workflow records.

optional.description: Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.

session.description: app.graycard.process.renderSession for this render or export event.

optional.description: Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.

inputs.description: Extra inputs, e.g. a mask or a second negative for a composite.

optional.description: Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.
Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.

photo.description: Deprecated convenience: published photo AT-URI (e.g. social.grain.photo). Prefer target.

otherStage.description: A stage whose operation is not represented by a built-in stage type, such as wet-plate collodion coating, toning, or mounting. kind names the operation and params stores operation-specific fields.

optional.description: Whether this planned occurrence may be skipped.

main.description: One workflow step (discriminated union).

steps.description: Ordered, stable-ID template steps. Repeated kinds are distinguished by each step's id.

connections.description: Directed artifact-flow graph over named step ports. The graph must be acyclic.

defaultChemistry.description: Default app.graycard.instance.chemistry for the primary developer or multi-role bath.

stageKinds.description: Legacy ordered stage kinds. New writers also write steps; readers normalize either representation.

stageDefaults.description: Legacy per-kind process defaults. New writers use step.processDefaults and may mirror these for older readers.

main.description: A reusable workflow template with stable ordered steps, typed defaults, and explicit artifact-flow topology.
